overview: The subcommittee reviewed executive and legislative provisions for Articles Two and Three of the proposed city charter, examining council composition, compensation, mayoral absence, and administrative oversight. Members agreed on multiple draft recommendations while deferring final proposals on term limits and a city auditor pending additional research.

items.title: Approval of Minutes
items.summary: The subcommittee approved the minutes of the previous meeting.

items.title: City Auditor and Oversight
items.summary: Members reviewed the existing roles of the city finance director and independent auditing firms, agreeing to request job descriptions and consult the Collins Center regarding council-appointed municipal auditors.

items.title: State of the City Report and Special Meetings
items.summary: The subcommittee supported requiring an annual state of the city report modeled after Weymouth's charter, while finding a separate provision empowering the mayor to call special council meetings unnecessary.

items.title: Mayoral Vacancy and Temporary Incapacity
items.summary: The subcommittee agreed to draft provisions designating the city council president to serve as or appoint an acting mayor in the event of temporary absence or incapacity.

items.title: Council Composition and Term Lengths
items.summary: Members endorsed an 11-member council with eight ward councilors and three at-large seats, supported a four-year mayoral term, and agreed to present split two-year ward and four-year at-large council terms to the full committee for discussion.

items.title: Elected Official Compensation
items.summary: The subcommittee agreed that council and mayoral compensation should be set by ordinance, recommending that pay increases take effect in subsequent terms and requiring a periodic salary review.

items.title: Mayoral Prohibitions
items.summary: Members agreed to adopt standard charter language prohibiting the mayor from holding other compensated municipal offices.

items.title: Ordinances, Vetoes, and Voting Procedures
items.summary: The subcommittee supported a standard mayoral veto with a two-thirds council override, prohibited final enactment on the date of introduction unless emergency or unanimous rules apply, and rejected individual-member charter objection mechanisms.

items.title: City Council President Powers and Decorum
items.summary: Members agreed to adopt standard charter language for the council president's procedural powers while leaving member discipline and recall procedures to council rules and later charter sections.

items.title: Term Limits and Meeting Planning
items.summary: The subcommittee deferred action on mayoral and council term limits to gather additional academic and municipal research, scheduling a follow-up meeting to finalize draft text.
